messages:
priya: Quick ping — PR #65872 (quantized-batching): needs runtime perf sign-off + security review on the crypto/kernel tweak. Planning a canary on Mon, aiming for a short window. Who can own runtime vs security?

kai: I can own runtime perf sign-off. I’ll run the perf deck and check p99/throughput. Need infra to run the load harness — @alex?

alex: I can do infra/load harness. Which harness to use, perf-runner or canary-runner?

priya: perf-runner is fine. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/65872 — small diff, mostly quant loader + kernel init.

dan: security here — I’ll take a look but need a quick summary of any changes touching RNG/KMS/HSM paths. Anything that alters key usage?

priya: TL;DR: 
```
- quant loader now calls secure_rng() during kernel init
- added optional kms-encrypted manifest header (X-Model-KMS)
- no new persistent keys, only ephemeral per-request nonces
```

alex: perf-runner has a 30m warmup. Can we shift canary to start 9:30am so we have warmup?

priya: ok shifting to 9:30–11:00am PST. @runtime-oncall-bot can you reserve that canary window and tag owners?

runtime-oncall-bot: Canary reserved: 2026-03-24T09:30-11:00 PST. Tagged: @kai, @alex, @dan.

kai: I’ll run perf deck and post numbers here. If p99 regresses >5% or throughput drops >7% we rollback.

dan: For security: please drop the KMS audit snippet and the stack trace where keys are read into the PR so I can confirm no leakage. If those look good I can LGTM today.

priya: uploaded audit snippet and a short note in the PR about where keys are read. Hoping for LGTM by 6pm so we can schedule the canary.

alex: :thumbsup: I’ll finish the load runs and post results by 5pm.

kai: Perf results: p99 +2%, throughput -1% on the perf deck after warmup. Numbers look within our tolerance. :white_check_mark:

dan: Security LGTM with one doc nit — leaving a comment on the PR.

priya: Thanks all. Assigning merge steward to @alex for the 9:30 canary window. I’ll be on-call for rollback coordination if anything pops.

alex: Got it — will merge at T-10min if all green.

priya: Appreciate it — will update the runbook with the rollback command and expected metrics to watch.
